科研.title: NEBench R1：用于评估大型语言模型核领域能力的推理基准
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for knowledge-intensive and safety-critical applications in nuclear engineering. However, existing nuclear-domain benchmarks provide limited content coverage or focus primarily on answer accuracy without systematically evaluating the quality of the underlying reasoning. This study introduces NEBench R1, a reasoning-oriented benchmark comprising 7,546 unique multiple-choice questions extracted from U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reactor operator licensing examinations covering 18 nuclear facilities. Each question is classified according to the NRC Knowledge and Abilities catalogs and accompanied by an official explanation serving as a reference for reasoning evaluation. Six LLMs were evaluated, with overall accuracy ranging from 34.0% to 73.9% across three distinct performance tiers. To assess reasoning quality, an LLM-based judge evaluated correctly answered responses using a multidimensional rubric. Although responses generally demonstrated strong problem comprehension, they scored lower in factual and procedural accuracy and distractor analysis, indicating that correct answers were not necessarily supported by technically sound justifications. Response clarity was also weakly indicative of technical quality. Furthermore, longer reasoning traces were associated with lower accuracy in both frontier reasoning models, suggesting that reasoning length may reflect question difficulty rather than improved problem-solving performance. Reasoning-token consumption may therefore provide an additional signal for identifying potentially unreliable responses. NEBench R1 establishes a benchmark for evaluating both answer accuracy and reasoning quality, providing a foundation for assessing the domain competence and reliability of LLMs in nuclear engineering.

科研.title: “连锁思维”的可控性可以降低“连锁思维”的可监测性
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents. One risk is that models could deliberately shape their reasoning to make it opaque to monitors. We stress-test this risk through persona-control training: supervised fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning traces rewritten in the voices of diverse personas. This induces a broader ability to control CoT, even though training contains no monitor-evasion examples. In covert side-task evaluations, traces in which a gpt-oss-20b model organism completes the hidden side task contain less monitorable evidence than the base model's. Averaged across evaluations and CoT lengths, weighted by side-task-success counts, the CoT monitorability metric g-mean$^2$ falls from 0.94 for the base model to 0.68 for the model organism without a hiding instruction, and to 0.22 when explicitly instructed to hide. In intervention evaluations, explicit hiding often drives monitorability near zero. The effect extends to a Kimi-K2.6 model organism in agentic environments, though hidden objectives requiring extended reasoning or longer trajectories remain more monitorable than simple single-step side tasks. We further discover that targeted transparency prompts can substantially recover monitorability, sometimes surpassing the base model. These model organisms provide a testbed for studying monitorability failures and potential mitigations. Our code can be found on https://github.com/yongzx/cot-control-model-organism.

科研.title: 在SAR车辆识别中，车辆的占比是多少？MSTAR 和 ATRNet-STAR 上的背景捷径、角度缺口和部分库
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep networks score near 99% on the MSTAR vehicle benchmark, and the newer ATRNet-STAR benchmark was built to be harder. We ask how much of these scores comes from the vehicle itself. With a modern network (ConvNeXt-Small, 3 seeds) we first reproduce the known MSTAR result: with the central 96x96 pixels zeroed out, accuracy is still 73.3% (chance 10%). The same shortcut is present in ATRNet-STAR, which was collected across several scenes: with the vehicle removed, accuracy is 63.3% on the 40-class SOC split (chance 2.5%). Under the official scene-change split, the background stops helping and starts hurting. Accuracy is 22.8% on full chips and 30.8% when only the vehicle is shown. A SAR foundation model, SARATR-X, leans on the background more than ConvNeXt does (+4 to +6 points with the vehicle removed, in every seed) and does not solve the scene change. We then hold the amount of training data fixed and vary the depression angles used for training. Accuracy is set mainly by the gap to the nearest training angle: 57% at 15 degrees, 39% at 30 degrees and 26% at 45 degrees. Adding more training angles does not help. Finally, when most classes have training images at the test angle and a few do not, the missing classes do worse than when no class has them: 9.0% instead of 22.4% at a 45-degree gap. Most of their images are assigned to known classes. We recommend reporting background-only and target-only controls, and the angle gap, next to any accuracy figure. Code is public.

科研.title: 审计员在人工智能安全研究的端到端转录中难以发现蓄意破坏行为
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21832v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As AI systems are increasingly used to automate AI R&D, misaligned systems could sabotage research intended to improve model safety and alignment. To stress-test defenses against such sabotage, we use a human expert as a proxy saboteur on AI safety research. We conduct a red-team/blue-team game where a human researcher runs AI safety experiments from scratch and auditors try to tell which were sabotaged and how. Given access to the full research transcript and the ability to run experiments, human auditors mostly fail to distinguish sabotaged from benign research: they achieve an AUROC of 0.59, not significantly better than chance, and fully identify the specific sabotage in only 17% of cases. Despite not being allowed to run experiments, the best frontier models outperform human auditors (Fable 5.1: AUROC 0.73, 32% full identification) within noise and weaker models perform comparably. When the saboteur chooses which experiments are attacked, rather than being required to sabotage every question given, sabotage identification drops further. Our results suggest that research sabotage by expert-level agents is difficult to detect with current auditing methods and provide a new setting for studying research sabotage.

科研.title: DeltaHarness：用于资源自适应工具执行的自进化线束
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21688v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-using agents rely on execution harnesses to organize and schedule tool operations. The same task and resource description can conceal runtime conditions that reverse the latency ordering of valid execution plans. Resolving this uncertainty requires firsthand execution in the target setting. We introduce DeltaHarness, an execution-guided policy-search method that adapts agent harnesses from cold-start measurements. Its QHI loop uses the observed response to update runtime dispatch, revise physical plans, and select experiments for later proposals. An independent confirmation panel controls policy replacement. With fixed dispatch, a revised materialization policy reduces complete-delivery latency by 30.0% on one video-editing task across three fresh pairs. On held-out tasks, the evolved policies reduce latency by 8.2% relative to the best fixed plan in one seed and by 4.6% relative to the initial proposal in another.

科研.title: AdaFlowLite：对异步移动数据的可扩展、非阻塞推理
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rise of mobile devices equipped with numerous sensors, such as LiDAR and cameras, has driven the adoption of multi-modal deep intelligence for distributed sensing tasks, such as smart cabins and driving assistance. However, the arrival time of mobile sensory data vary due to modality size and network dynamics, which can lead to delays (if waiting for slow data) or accuracy decline (if inference proceeds without waiting). Moreover, the diversity and dynamic nature of mobile systems exacerbate this challenge. In response, we present a shift to \textit{opportunistic} inference for asynchronous distributed multi-modal data, enabling inference as soon as partial data arrives. While existing methods focus on optimizing modality consistency and complementarity, known as modal affinity, they lack a \textit{computational} approach to control this affinity in open-world mobile environments. % \sysname pioneers the formulation of structured cross-modality affinity in mobile contexts using a hierarchical analysis-based normalized matrix. This approach accommodates the diversity and dynamics of modalities, generalizing across different types and numbers of inputs. Employing an multi-modal lightweight Swin Transformer (MMLST), \sysname facilitates real-time and flexible data imputation, adapting to various modalities and downstream tasks without retraining. Experiments show that \sysname significantly reduces inference latency by up to 80.4\% and enhances accuracy by up to 62.1\%, while achieving nearly a 50\% reduction in energy consumption, outperforming status quo approaches. Also, this method can enhance LLM performance to preprocess asynchronous data.

科研.title: TIBECG：用于ECG波形发布中导联特异性人口统计隐私的时间信息瓶颈
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transmitting an electrocardiogram (ECG) waveform can expose demographic information beyond an intended diagnostic task. We evaluate TIBECG, an architectural temporal information bottleneck, on individual leads extracted from hospital twelve-lead recordings. A 2,302,337-parameter processor varies its latent length while retaining the same nine-score consistency objective, without age or sex labels in protector fitting. Across 6,386 recordings, ten folds, 12 leads and 21 lengths, retrospective selections retained at least 95% of each lead's clean macro-F1. Their weaker age/sex interval gain exceeded the best eligible conventional transformation on all leads, by a median 22.08 percentage points. The implemented sampling-rate comparison shows that direct downsampling usually suppresses demographic inference more strongly but at a larger loss of diagnostic utility, whereas TIBECG favors utility preservation. Selection stability also varies by lead. Lower latent Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence does not reliably rank residual sex leakage at a fixed length. These findings support lead-specific evaluation of waveform processing, not validated consumer deployment or expert-readable reconstruction. When the waveform-input diagnostic classifier is hosted as part of a proprietary cloud service rather than deployed on the device, waveform transmission is required to obtain its scores.

科研.title: 视觉网络中的逐层学习率缩放：有效率识别、幂平均聚合和预算依赖性
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21696v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layerwise learning-rate scaling assigns different learning rates to different parts of a network. Although established in fine-tuning pretrained models, its effects in vision networks trained from scratch are commonly assessed by training each candidate recipe. We show that, in this setting, the rate-related component of a layerwise strategy is well summarized by an effective learning rate computable directly from its multiplier profile. Across matched-control comparisons, changes in test accuracy closely track changes in training loss (r = -0.996), which supports an optimization-progress explanation of the short-budget rate effect. Increasing the untuned base learning rate tenfold shifts the rate-matched contrast upward in all six tested architectures (p = 0.016) and increases the number of architectures in which a published discriminative schedule, excluded from model fitting, outperforms the uniform control from two to five of six (p = 0.031). Within the evaluated strategy space, a parameter-weighted power mean with exponent 0.35 (95% confidence interval [0.20, 0.50]) accounts for 42.6% of within-architecture variance, compared with 36.4% for the arithmetic mean. Ranking candidates by this scalar without training improves the selected candidate's mean percentile rank from the 26th to the 10th and reduces its mean accuracy shortfall relative to the best candidate from 3.70 to 1.12 points. The rate-related effect decays as the training budget increases; relative to tuned baselines, the overall strategy effect falls within the prespecified practical-equivalence margin in two of three architectures. A separate grouping-related contrast can persist at long budgets, although its direction and magnitude depend on the architecture.

科研.title: 使用经典和机器学习的原子间势能研究LiF的动力学和输运
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We perform molecular dynamics simulations of molten Lithium Fluoride, comparing the classical Buckingham and Born-Huggins-Mayer potentials with machine-learnt interatomic potentials - the MACE-MP-0b3 (small) foundation model potential, and a fine-tuned version thereof. We find that the MACE-MP-0b3, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental shear viscosity across the liquid state comparable with polarisable potentials despite not itself being polarisable. Previous viscosities computed using classical potentials are under-predicted, which has previously been attributed to a suppressed melting temperature. Prompted by this we compare the melting points of these potentials. We find that the machine-learnt potentials address the significant underestimation of the melting point of the classical potentials, though the refined potential and the foundation model differ significantly between themselves. We probe the microscopic structure and dynamics of each model to further elucidate the considerable change in viscosity between classical and machine-learnt potentials. We find that, despite their lower melting temperature, classical potentials produce considerably stiffer, higher frequency, single-particle and collective charge-transport dynamics on account of their fixed charges. However, in the long-wavelength limit, the many-body machine-learnt potentials feature more elastic collective motion that governs the diffusion of momentum and is therefore responsible for the enhanced shear viscosity.

科研.title: quantEM：从可微物理到神经先验的定量电子显微镜分析
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.21903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantitative electron microscopy includes imaging, diffraction, spectroscopy, and tomography measurements, and the analysis of these measurements increasingly requires solving inverse problems with physical forward models. Open-source software has made many of these analyses widely available, but most packages are organized around a single modality, so that multimodal analyses require moving data between packages, and new methods cannot easily reuse the physical models and optimizers of existing ones. Here we present quantEM, an open-source Python package for quantitative electron microscopy that uses PyTorch tensors for computation and automatic differentiation, and Zarr for storage. We implement each analysis method by writing a differentiable forward model and choosing a representation, loss function, constraints, and optimizer from a library of components, so that every method runs on CPUs and GPUs, can be saved and resumed, and uses the same calibrated data structures and visualization tools. We describe the current modules, including orientation and strain mapping, direct and iterative ptychography, tomography with neural representations, and X-ray and electron energy-loss spectroscopy, and show how we assemble combined methods such as ptychographic tomography from existing components. quantEM is available under the MIT license, together with documentation, tutorials, and curated example datasets.

科研.title: 材料科学的权重空间编程
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.22013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A materials discovery campaign often begins with almost no measurements of the property it is searching for, and the models that rank candidates or screen the output of a generator then have to be built from those first few labels. Following recent work on weight-space programming, in which a language model writes the weights of a small network directly as text, we show that a general-purpose model, given the task in words, the names of the inputs and a network of 16 hidden units with every weight set to zero, can provide this starting point by filling in all of the weights from what it has learned about materials. With no labels, the networks of the strongest model rank experimental alloys at Spearman co-efficient = 0.64 to 0.79, where the best of five simple descriptors reaches 0.47 to 0.62. They rank the bulk modulus of crystals added during generative discovery loops at 0.95, where the inverse volume per atom reaches 0.89, and 35 phase-equilibrium targets computed with Thermo-Calc at a mean of 0.67, close to the 0.70 of an extrapolation from calculated binary and ternary data. As the prior mean of a Gaussian process they raise the ranking at five labels from 0.35 to 0.69 on alloys and from 0.15 to 0.95 on crystals, and they lower the regret of Bayesian optimization significantly on 4 of 5 experimental tasks and on 13 to 16 of 33 computed targets, depending on how multiple tests are corrected, without raising it significantly on any. The same networks also serve as the mean of a Bayesian neural network and as a screen for the samples of two crystal generators, where they do as well as standard models trained on 400 labeled structures. The gain is confined to the first tens of labels and to targets that no rule or sub-system extrapolation already ranks.

科技.title: 谷歌出手：Play 应用商店 2027 年 4 月起安卓应用必须适配折叠屏手机
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，谷歌昨日（11 月 18 日）发布公告，宣布 Google Play 全新“自适应应用质量标准”，将折叠屏和大屏体验从“加分项”变成“准入门槛”， 并计划从 2027 年 4 月开始，开发者必须满足折叠屏和大屏设备的最低适配要求，否则应用将无法在 Google Play 发布或更新。 IT之家援引博文介绍，谷歌将应用适配划分为三个层级： 第 3 层级：自适应就绪（Tier 3：Adaptive ready）： 应用必须填满可用的显示区域，不采用信箱模式或兼容模式。应用必须在旋转、折叠 / 展开和调整大小期间保留状态（滚动位置、文本输入、媒体播放），同时支持多窗口模式。 全屏应用内容。 第 2 层级：自适应优化（Tier 2: Adaptive optimized）： 评估自适应多窗格布局，避免界面元素拉伸，并针对可折叠设备、平板电脑和其他大屏设备上的外部键盘、鼠标、触控板和触控笔输入提供基本支持。 多窗格布局。 第 1 层级：自适应差异化（Tier 1: Adaptive differentiated） ：评估媒体、视频、阅读和多任务处理应用的桌面模式和书本模式、相机连续性、互动式画中画和多实例支持。 感知可折叠设备的折叠状态。 新规重点解决折叠屏上应用显示不完整、切换屏幕后使用中断等问题。按照最低的 Tier 3 标准，应用必须充分利用可用显示区域，不能依赖黑边或兼容模式运行；在旋转、折叠、展开及调整窗口大小时，需要保留阅读位置、已输入文字和媒体播放状态，同时支持多窗口使用。 在约束措施方面，自 2027 年 4 月起，开发者除提供原有的两张手机截图外，还需提交三张折叠屏截图，覆盖规定比例的展开内屏和折叠外屏。这些截图可通过真机或安卓模拟器获取，目前已开放上传。 谷歌表示，用户手中的安卓生态大屏设备已超过 5.8 亿台。后续质量框架将逐步纳入更高等级要求，涉及多栏布局、外接输入设备及折叠姿态专属体验，并扩展至平板等设备。 到了 2027 年 8 月，新应用和更新还需要面向 Android 17 的 API 37，进一步配合大屏窗口和方向适配规则。 相关阅读： 《 谷歌主动推动安卓折叠屏应用适配，Google Play 商店明年将引入评估机制 》

科技.title: 英伟达披露 GPU 租赁价格上涨：Hopper 最高翻倍，B300 涨超 60%
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，英伟达在最新财报电话会议上披露，随着 AI 推理需求持续增长，公司旗下不同代际 GPU 的租赁价格均出现上涨。 其中，Hopper 架构 GPU 的多年期续约租赁价格最高达原价 2 倍，Blackwell 架构 B300 GPU 的租赁价格较推出时上涨超过 60%。 据 Wccftech 报道，英伟达临时 CEO、首席财务官科莱特 · 克雷斯（Colette Kress）在财报电话会议上表示，自今年 5 月以来，AI 词元价格下降近 60%，进一步刺激了 AI 使用量和算力需求增长，推动不同代际 GPU 的租赁价格上涨。她还表示，英伟达提供给超大规模云服务商和新兴云服务商的计算资源目前均处于满负荷使用状态。 英伟达此前披露的数据显示，B300 GPU 的租赁价格较推出时上涨超过 60%。这表明算力租赁市场的价格上涨并不局限于新一代产品，上一代 Hopper 架构产品同样受到需求增长的影响。 消费级显卡市场也出现涨价消息。据博板堂爆料，技嘉显卡工厂及华硕显卡工厂现已执行 11 月份最新成本价格调整政策，针对大部分型号成本价格全面涨价。其中，RTX 5080 系列上涨 1000 元，RTX 5060 系列上涨 150 元。 中国 AI 企业还面临海外算力租赁渠道收紧的问题。据《金融时报》报道，英伟达已要求全球数据中心及云服务合作伙伴，将至少 51% 的服务提供给非中国客户。这项要求通过英伟达销售团队口头传达，适用于未来签订的合同，不涉及现有租赁协议。 《金融时报》报道称，一套国际市场售价约 60 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 400.8 万元人民币） 的 B300 机架系统，上个月在中国市场的售价据称达到 1850 万元人民币。报道指出，英伟达收紧海外云服务客户限制，可能进一步影响中国企业获取先进 AI GPU 算力的渠道。 相关阅读： 《 轻信短视频“英伟达 RTX 5080 显卡降价近万元”虚假消息，杭州一居民被骗 1.58 万元 》 《 消息称黄仁勋曾力推 RTX 5080 24GB 显卡安抚游戏玩家，如今英伟达或将其取消 》 《 24Gb GDDR7 价格过高，传 16GB 版本 GeForce RTX 5080 显卡回归市场 》 《 消息称华硕 / 技嘉显卡工厂已执行最新成本价格调整政策：RTX5080 系列涨 1000 元、5060 涨 150 元 》

科技.title: 腾讯大幅削减元宝投入：没有我们预期的那样成功
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，腾讯控股 11 月 18 日发布 2026 年第三季度业绩。当季收入 2073.36 亿元，同比增长 8％；非国际财务报告准则（Non-IFRS）经营盈利 680.73 亿元，同比下降 6％。不过， 剔除新 AI 产品贡献后，同口径经营盈利为 833 亿元，同比增长 8％ 。 据长安街知事今日报道，在稍晚举行的业绩会上，腾讯披露了微信 AI 助手小微的运营数据。腾讯总裁刘炽平也坦言， 另一款 AI 助手元宝并未达到预期 。 “大家也能看到，元宝没有我们预期的那样成功。”刘炽平表示，元宝现在不再只把用户规模当作目标，重心回到提升模型能力，进展不错。同时， 腾讯大幅削减了在元宝上的投入 。 刘炽平还在业绩会上表示， 腾讯正持续扩大微信“小微”的用户测试池 ，目前日活用户已达 3000 万。同时，小微全面上线后的季度成本，将低于今年早些时候元宝的季度成本。 腾讯元宝于 2024 年 5 月正式发布，是一款面向消费者端的 AI 助手。为了推广元宝， 腾讯去年甚至在微信限时推出了元宝的下载入口 。 IT之家注意到，今年春节，腾讯元宝曾推出“分 10 亿现金红包”活动，2 月 18 日活动结束后， 腾讯宣布元宝日活跃用户超 5000 万 ，月活跃用户达 1.14 亿。
